correctness.rationale: The exact root-zonotope width formula follows by Minkowski segment additivity. On each strict order chamber the linear gradient has squared norm \(n(n^2-1)/3\), proving every maximum and its exact count. For each zero-mean level-block vector an ordered positive combination of step vectors proves T_m(z)≥sqrt(m(m−1))||z||, with equality examples; tangent vectors at any two-level cut split into two zero-mean blocks, and before inter-block crossing the cross terms cancel exactly, giving the attained sharp cos–sin angle formula. For \(r\ge3\) coordinate levels, restriction to the positive-dimensional block-constant sphere excludes minima; block splitting excludes non-maximal-tie maxima. This exhausts all cases for all \(n\ge3\). A standalone Python 3 checker independently corroborates 48,534 integer inequalities, 275 cut-size profiles and attained geodesics, and 5,910 maximum-order profiles, but only the proof establishes the infinite theorem.
